songs.lyrics:
[verse 1]
Back wall, arms crossed, coat still on
I came because somebody asked me twice
Forty people, maybe less than that
The drummer counts it off with his mouth
I am not going to like this, I decide

[pre-chorus]
Third song in, my arms come down
I don't remember when that happened

[chorus]
I Stayed for This, I didn't plan to
Somebody up there means every word
The room is small and that is the point
Nobody's filming, nobody's leaving

[verse 2]
The guitar's out of tune and nobody minds
She says the next one is about her sister
Somebody's beer goes over on my shoe
I laugh out loud for the first time all week
I put my hands in my pockets and stay

[instrumental break]

[final chorus]
I Stayed for This, I didn't plan to
Somebody up there means every word
The room is small and that is the point
I'll say I was here when they were nobody
I Stayed for This, I didn't plan to

[intro]

[verse 1: Male Vocal]
Take the long way, come off at the second light

songs.lyrics:
[hook intro]
Still in Your Ears

[verse 1]
Your shoes are wet and you do not care
Four blocks of nobody, all of it yours
The low note is still going in your head
You hum it wrong and then you get it
A taxi slows down and you wave it on

[chorus]
Still in Your Ears, the whole way home
Your heart is running slower than the beat was
Every window on the street is dark
And the pavement keeps the time for you
You take the long way for no reason

[verse 2]
The bakery light is on already, warm
Somebody is starting their day as you end yours
Your ears are ringing and you like it
You will pay for this at nine o'clock
Not one part of you wants to be asleep

[breakdown]

[final chorus]
Still in Your Ears, the whole way home
Your heart is running slower than the beat was
The sky is doing something behind the flats
You put your key in very quietly
Still in Your Ears, the whole way home
